data.explanation: This is a bill from your electrician for work done in your home. It lists the parts and labor, adds 19% VAT, and asks for payment within 14 days of the invoice date (not from when you received it). Check the amount and work described match what was agreed, then transfer the total to the IBAN shown using the invoice number as reference so the payment can be matched. If you don't pay by the deadline shown, the company can send reminders and eventually charge late-payment interest or take collection action. Electrician invoices for work in your home may qualify as deductible household craftsman services (Handwerkerleistungen) on your German tax return, so keep this invoice for your records.
